whatIs: Signalicon is a library of more than 1,000 outline-style icons for web and apps, created by SignalSupply. They download as SVG or Figma files, and each icon can be copied as SVG straight from the page.
It's a good fit when you want a consistent set of interface icons, especially if you design in Figma, and you're willing to pay for the full set.
uses: Copy an icon's SVG with the stroke set to currentColor so it picks up the text color in a web app.
Have a uniform set of icons in a project's Figma library.
Reuse the same icons across several projects or clients with a single PRO license.
caveats: Only about 46 icons are marked as free; the rest of the library requires PRO.
The PRO license covers one user, with unlimited projects and clients; it's a one-time payment and non-refundable.
The PRO price goes up as icons are added, and the Figma files and bulk SVGs are downloaded from Gumroad after purchase.
pricingNote: There are 46 free icons; the PRO license costs $48 in a single payment and unlocks the full set.
idealFor: Designers and developers who want a set of outline icons for interfaces.
